tei:titleStmt.tei:title: A Blessing over Water for Peace, Health, Joy, Prosperity, and Kindness — by Rabbi Zalman Schachter-Shalomi (ca. 2004)

tei:div.tei:head: A Blessing over Water for Peace, Health, Joy, Prosperity, and Kindness — by Rabbi Zalman Schachter-Shalomi (ca. 2004)

tei:l.tei:note: Before using any vessel, immerse it in a mikveh or a free-flowing natural body of water.

tei:div.tei:p: who hallowed us with their mitsvot,
and obligated us to immerse a new vessel.

Barukh atah,
Adonai Eloheinu,
melekh ha-olam,
asher kidshanu bemitsvotav,
vetsivanu al tevilat kli

tei:l.tei:note: Before drinking water or any healthy liquid, make a blessing to acknowledge the one from whom all is created.

tei:div.tei:p: Who brings all things into being through their word (logos).

Barukh atah,
Adonai Eloheinu,
melekh ha-olam,
shehakol nih’yeh bid’varo

tei:l.tei:note: And after you feel satiated, remember to bless.

tei:div.tei:p: who creates a diverse multitude of creatures,
each shaped with a dependency (ḥesronan, lit. ‘absence’)
through which it is enlivened with the Spirit of Life.
Blessed is the Life of the Worlds.

Barukh atah
Adonai Eloheinu
melekh ha‘olam
borei nefashot
rabot veḥesronan
al kol mah shebara’ta
lehaḥayot bahem
nefesh kol ḥai
barukh ḥei ha‘olamim
